name: flaggems_functional_assert_async
description: Functional assert_async: checks that `self` is a single-element (numel==1) nonzero tensor and raises RuntimeError(assert_msg) otherwise; returns a clone of `dep_token` used as an autograd dependency token. Native dispatch is CPU-only in this build, so the reference emulates the exact semantics device-agnostically (works on the target GPU device).
